_comment: All timing values from ROM disassembly. Frame values at 60 FPS (NTSC ~60.0988 Hz). 1 frame ≈ 16.64ms.

grapple._note: Grapple countdown starts at $1F (31). Stomp cue fires at frame 14 ($0E). Input closest to cue wins.

movement._note: Speeds from ROM table $9143. All wrestlers share identical movement speeds. Pixels per frame at NES 256px screen width.

pinfall._note: Pin setup takes 30 frames ($1E), referee needs 20 frames ($14) to get into position. Each count is 60 frames. Cannot complete 3-count if opponent HP >= 62 ($3E).

ringOut._note: 20-count with 1 second per count. Count starts after brief delay when wrestler exits ring.

turnbuckle._note: Climbing is 16 frames ($10, 0.267 sec) per climbing step. Fast climb compared to our original estimate.

stun._note: Stun duration is HP-dependent: lower HP = longer stun. Max auto-getup capped at 191 frames ($BF, 3.18 sec). At 240 HP, light stun = 7 frames; at 60 HP, heavy knockdown = capped 191 frames.

healthRegen._note: Heal accumulator adds 6 per frame. At 256 overflow (~43 frames / 0.71s), restores 1 HP up to 239 cap. Slow passive regen during idle/neutral play.

match._note: Bell rings 2 seconds after match screen loads. No time limit (0 = unlimited).

difficulty._comment: CPU AI scales across 4 tiers based on FightCount >> 2 (matches 1-4, 5-8, 9-12, 13-16).

tiers._note: Great Puma tier. Fastest reactions, highest reversal/block rates.

phases.name: VWA Championship Quest
phases.description: Face the other 5 playable wrestlers. Match 5 is the VWA Championship.
phases._note: Order for Fighter Hayabusa. If playing as King Slender, Giant Panther replaces him as Match 5 champion.

phases.name: VWA Title Defenses
phases.description: Exactly 10 consecutive title defense matches, two 5-match loops across the roster.

phases.name: VWF Unification Match
phases.description: CHALLENGE DOUBLE TITLE match against The Great Puma (VWF Champion).

ring._note: NES-scale dimensions (256x240 screen). Ring mat centered. Ropes inset from mat edge.

sprites._note: NES PPU 8x8 sprite mode. Each wrestler is a 3x4 tile metasprite (24x32 px, 12 hardware sprites).

viewport._note: Virtual resolution is 480x360 (1.875x NES 256x240). NES-scale values multiplied by scaleFactor for world coords.
